content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IGRUA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGRUA Aircraft Maintenance Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IGRUA Aircraft Maintenance Engineer posts is 12th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer position at Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this IGRUA recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Aircraft Maintenance Engineering degree in a relevant stream or a B.Sc in Physics/Mathematics, along with an AME License in Category B1/B2 for specific aircraft types.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 55 years as of 01-06-2026. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer posts will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 91000 to Rs. 92900.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IGRUA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this IGRUA job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi located?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) is located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 229302.

faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA).
